== Summary ==
Chris Stevenson placed second in the Wild Card and advanced directly to the Star Trek CCG World finals. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999#Star Trek CCG World Championship|Star Trek CCG at DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
